publication.head: codex/5587-google-drive-context-mirror
publication.title: [v0.91.8][google-workspace][automation] Make ADL Drive context mirror work end to end
publication.body:
Closes #5587

Implements native Google Drive execution for the ADL context mirror, deterministic regeneration of the four declared seed files, recursive path-preserving mirroring of declared Markdown trees, and fail-closed verification of listings, metadata, MIME type, parent, identity, exact bytes, and SHA-256. The automation contract archives successful sync tasks only after complete verification and preserves actionable failures.

Focused proof: 21 Drive-sync tests, 11 context-mirror tests, 5 production-binary tests, proof-selector contract tests, exact-head review with no findings, and authenticated live Drive readback with exact content parity. No AWS or Spot used.
